issues.observed: The closed model provides Frontend_Collision_Detected, Rear_End_Collision_Detected, and Pedestrian_Collision_Detected consumers from Inactive into FrontendCollision, RearEndCollision, and PedestrianCollision; no distinct closed-model event named for a possible frontend collision is supplied.
issues.reason: The exact ActiveState scope has three source/model activation transitions from Inactive, but the supplied trigger facts show only the three named collision events as consumers. The source/model comparison therefore supports the required trigger-set relation; however, the wording "possible frontend collision" is not represented by a separately declared closed-model event distinct from Frontend_Collision_Detected, so the semantic trigger correspondence remains a precise mismatch candidate rather than being silently normalized.

issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source phrase may be a natural-language paraphrase of the supplied Frontend Collision Detected event, in which case the three closed-model consumers exactly cover the intended activation set.
issues.title: Collision-avoidance activation trigger set is incomplete

issues.basis: NL3 contract, exact ActiveState source/model binding, source inventory child composites FrontendCollisionRegion, RearEndCollisionRegion, and PedestrianCollisionRegion, canonical concurrent_regions count 0, and inspection-equivalent containment facts.
issues.expected: ActiveState has orthogonal regions permitting concurrent activation of different collision-avoidance controls.
issues.observed: ActiveState contains three named composite child states, but the supplied closed-model structural projection reports zero concurrent regions; the children are not established as orthogonal regions.
issues.reason: The exact ActiveState composite contains three child composites, but the supplied canonical/model projection reports zero concurrent regions and no explicit orthogonal partition structure. This is a structural mismatch with the contract's independently required orthogonality and concurrent-control semantics.
issues.requirement_quote: The orthogonal regions of the active mode of collision avoidance allow for concurrent activation different of collision avoidance controls.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The three child composites could be intended as independently active controls despite the absence of explicit concurrent-region metadata, but the supplied facts do not establish that interpretation.
issues.title: Active mode lacks orthogonal concurrent regions
